action_summary: Added 4-view flip test-time augmentation (original, horizontal flip, vertical flip, both) to the inference step, since the fixed Xception model was trained with random left-right and up-down flips so all four views are in-distribution; predictions from the four views are averaged (AUC is rank based, so mean of probabilities is appropriate), each view is saved to .npy for later re-blending, and the result is NaN-cleaned and clipped to [0,1]. Increased inference batch size from 8 to 16 to offset the 4x prediction cost, removed the unused train_test_split import, and wrapped the activation visualisation in try/except so it cannot prevent the submission from being written. Submission format and Kaggle paths are unchanged.
